definitions.explanation: The amount of food placed on a dish or in a bowl. Also refers to the way food is arranged and presented on a plate.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}{盛|も}りにして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make it a large serving.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しくて→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もったいない→もったいない：02642_mottainai⟧くらいだった。
examples.english: The salad was so beautifully arranged that it almost seemed a waste to eat it.

notes:
USAGE:
The nominal form of the verb ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ (to heap, to serve). Very commonly used in compound forms: {大|おお}{盛|も}り (large serving), ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧{盛|も}り (regular serving), {特|とく}{盛|も}り (extra-large serving). At restaurants, {盛|も}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ means the portions are generous. Also used for the visual presentation of food ({盛|も}り⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ = plating).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{盛|も}り: large serving
- {特|とく}{盛|も}り: extra-large serving
- {盛|も}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: generous portions
- {盛|も}り⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: food plating/arrangement
- {盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ: assorted platter
